title: Bashar :: "The Triad Mind" - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar introduces the concept of the Triad Mind, describing three interconnected consciousness systems: the higher mind, heart mind, and head mind. The higher mind emits a frequency that flows through the physical headline, creating resonance primarily in the heart mind. The heart and higher mind are tuned to each other in a particular way, with the heart functioning as the physical organ that resonates the frequency of the higher mind. This foundational teaching establishes the energetic hierarchy and interconnection between these three aspects of consciousness.

qa_topics.question: Can you perform an energy scan on me?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Bashar confirms he performs energy scans during all interactions. Upon scanning the questioner, he prescribes remaining in a writing flow state to maintain peak energy alignment with their authentic self.

key_terms.term: aligned with who you truly are
write the story of your life

quotes.quote: The heart and higher mind are tuned to each other in a very particular way
The heart is the organ that resonates the frequency of the higher mind in physical terms
When you are in the flow of writing your energy is at its peak
Stay there in all things that you do so you will write the story aligned with who you are
The inspirations are already contained in that state of being
You will download what you need when you need it
